[font=Trebuchet MS]I made an Eri mod! Eri is a character from Boku no Hero Academia and she is very cute. This mod is for female toddler only. I hope you enjoy!

[/font][img]https://i.imgur.com/lXprzrk.png[/img]

[font=Trebuchet MS][b]Requirements[/b]
Content Patcher
SMAPI[/font]

[b]Instructions
[/b][font=Trebuchet MS]Extract the file into your mods folder[/font]
[font=Trebuchet MS]Steam > steamapps > common > Stardew Valley > Mods[/font]

[size=2]I have created two versions of Eri's sprite. One with shorter hair and one with longer hair. The shorter hairstyle is more accurate to the character and is set as the default, but if you wish to try the longer hair, go into the content folder and change [/size][size=2]"FromFile": "assets/Eri.png" to "FromFile": "assets/EriLH.png"

Please do not reupload this mod (or modifications and/or recolors of this mod) anywhere else. Thank you all for taking an interest in my mod![/size][/center]
